build_iqn_network: build an IQNNetwork with a convolutional torso and MLP head for implicit quantile regression
create_quantile_embedding: create a cosine-based quantile threshold embedding using the IQNNetwork _create_embedding method
run_iqn_forward_pass: run a forward pass through IQNNetwork to get Q-values, quantile distribution, and tau thresholds
review_iqn_network_call: review the IQNNetwork __call__ method to understand how torso output merges with tau embeddings
refactor_iqn_network_init: refactor the IQNNetwork __init__ to add custom default values for latent_dim and num_quantile_samples
